MERPUI.Settings.ContentLanguage.Name: MERP-RMU Content Language
MERPUI.Settings.ContentLanguage.Hint: Selects the language used by MERP-RMU editorial content. Changes are applied immediately.
MERPUI.Settings.ThemeEnabled.Name: Enable MERP UI theme
MERPUI.Settings.ThemeEnabled.Hint: Applies PragRoman and the MERP layout to Journals, Actors and Items.
MERPUI.Settings.DefaultIconSize.Name: Default MERP icon size
MERPUI.Settings.DefaultIconSize.Hint: Default size used for MERP icons.
MERPUI.Settings.CampaignAge.Name: MERP-RMU — Campaign Age
MERPUI.Settings.CampaignAge.Hint: Determines the age-specific variant applied when a MERP-RMU Race or Culture is dragged from a Compendium.
MERPUI.Settings.Magic.Enabled.Name: MERP-RMU — Magic Consequences Automation
MERPUI.Settings.Magic.Enabled.Hint: Triggers the Risk of Attracting the Shadow after each RMU SCR and automatic Sorcery checks.
MERPUI.Settings.Magic.AgePeriod.Name: MERP-RMU — Period for Magic Risk
MERPUI.Settings.Magic.AgePeriod.SecondLa: Second Age — War of the Last Alliance (+25)
MERPUI.Settings.Magic.Region.Name: MERP-RMU — Current Region Type
MERPUI.Settings.Magic.Region.Hint: Used to determine the consequence when the Shadow detects a spell.
MERPUI.Settings.Magic.ShadowWhisper.Name: MERP-RMU — Keep Shadow Rolls Secret
MERPUI.Settings.Magic.ShadowWhisper.Hint: Risk and Corruption cards are whispered to GMs.
MERPUI.Settings.FirstRun.Title: Welcome to MERP-UI
MERPUI.Settings.FirstRun.Body: MERP-UI is ready. Before creating characters, choose the MERP-RMU content language and set the Campaign Age in Game Settings. MERP-UI also inserts the Middle-earth campaign languages directly into the RMU Campaign Languages setting. For a guided setup, open the MERP-UI Installation & Settings Guide.
MERPUI.Settings.FirstRun.ReopenHint: You can reopen this guide at any time with MERPUI.showSettingsGuide().
